[[File:Kindsrpter.jpg|thumb|250px|A kinetic corruptor during [[Operation Influx]]]]
The '''kinetic corruptors''' were massive machines used during the [[Republic Dark Age]] to extract energy from [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] deposits on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chelloa]]. Due to their massive size, the kinetic corruptors relied on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] for transportation and dwarfed many [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] classes, including [[cargo liner]]s and [[Landing craft/Legends|landing ships]]. The kinetic corruptors extracted baradium's power by exploding a portion of the crust, generating much [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activity and destroying the landscape in the process. One such machine was used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]'s forces in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] during an [[Operation Influx|attack]] on his brother [[Daiman]]'s forces and a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] team led by [[Vannar Treece]]. The attack killed many [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] laborers, Daiman's troops, and most of the Jedi with the exception of [[Kerra Holt]].<ref name="SWKE1">[[Knight Errant 1|''Knight Errant'' 1]]</ref> Odion's modular [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[The Spike (space station)|The Spike]] was used to manufacture kinetic corruptors.<ref name="SWKE3">[[Knight Errant 3|''Knight Errant'' 3]]</ref>

Daiman would subsequently deploy ten kinetic corruptors on Chelloa disguised as [[mobile munitions complex]]es, large interstellar-capable war forges. Daiman leaked false intelligence to Odion that he was expanding baradium mining operations and had imported the mobile war forges for military production. Odion fell for the bait and deployed a large ground assault force consisting of the [[Lightning Guard]]. In the [[Destruction of Chelloa|ensuing battle]], the kinetic corruptors ignited the surrounding landmass, destroying Odion's invasion force, but failing to kill the Sith Lord. However, the kinetic corruptors unleashed a wave of explosions which destroyed Chelloa's surface beneath a sea of burning [[Magma/Legends|magma]]. However, much of the population had been evacuated on the [[Freedom Fleet]] through the efforts of Holt and [[Chelloan resistance]] leader [[Gorlan Palladane]].<ref name="SWKE5">[[Knight Errant 5|''Knight Errant'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The design of the kinetic corruptor was based on the look of a [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] wing strut removed from the cockpit and the wing.<ref name="LEGO">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html|text=Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''}}</ref>
